brief:
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said his country will continue to "courageously speak truth and state facts," vowing not to retreat from its positions until those who commit crimes against humanity face legal accountability, according to Shehab Wire.

Erdoğan made the comments as Turkey has maintained sustained criticism of military operations in Gaza, with the president framing Ankara's stance as a principled commitment to justice and human rights.
